title: Public Alert No. 05/2025 – Alert on the Circulation of Falsified Cikatem (Artemether 180mg/Lumefantrine 1080mg) with Falsified NAFDAC Registration Number NRN A11-100025
summary: NAFDAC warns of falsified Cikatem (Artemether 180mg/Lumefantrine 1080mg) suspension found at the Kano Coordinated Wholesale Centre. It bears NAFDAC number A11-100025, which belongs to Cikatem Tablet 20/120mg. 17,280 bottles held at the maker for destruction.
